description.zh: 大脑能同时抓住的东西很有限：工作记忆一次只维持几个单元，把项目分组能腾出空间；注意像带宽有限的通道，干扰越多越难找到目标；记忆痕迹随时间变弱，新旧内容还会互相干扰，而一个好的提取线索能把它拉回来。
description.en: The mind can hold only a little at once: working memory keeps a handful of units in play, and grouping items frees up room; attention is a channel of limited bandwidth, so more distractors make targets harder to find; memory traces fade with time and old and new material interfere, while a good retrieval cue can bring them back.

aliases.zh: 前摄干扰 后摄干扰

label.zh: 目标是信号，干扰物与它争道

reason.zh: 本页把注意当作带宽有限的通道：目标是要找的信号，干扰物同时涌入，干扰越多命中率越低。信号检测论是继续读这类任务的标准方法：它把“分不分得开”（d′）与“多愿意说有”（判据 c）分开，本页的模型只画出前一种方向。
reason.en: The page treats attention as a limited channel: targets are the signal you look for, distractors arrive alongside them, and hits fall as distractors rise. Signal detection theory is the standard way to read such a task further: it separates how well targets can be told apart (d′) from how readily one says “yes” (criterion c); the page models only the first.
